notes.title: Vivid Surf Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Hey!
Letting you all know that I'm participating now in the Steam Next Fest starting today (21st) to the 28th. Sorry about announcing it late, been flat out adding features to help new players and fixing bugs. 

This demo contains 5 tutorial levels with 3 bonus levels, two of which will require some finesse to experience. Also, the first portion of the climb game mode is playable (save locations are disabled in this mode).

Would love to hear feedback, in the demo’s menu there is a link in the bottom right to the survey.
